  "pros": [
    "Excellent for visual tracking of client-related projects.",
    "Streamlined collaboration with internal teams on deliverables.",
    "Improved visibility into task progress and deadlines."

  "cons": [
    "Could feel limited for comprehensive CRM functions beyond project tracking.",
    "Initial setup for diverse client workflows required some effort.",
    "Reporting features were sometimes basic for their specific needs."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This Key Account Manager found Asana to be a highly effective tool for organizing and managing various client-related project boards. The visual nature of the boards and strong collaboration features significantly improved their ability to track client initiatives and coordinate with internal teams, though they noted some limitations when it came to more detailed CRM functionality and reporting."
